assign.brief: The owner reported on the /framework/ux/Dictate/ page: 'Both of the messages from the fast and smart assistants were added twice to this chat for some reason. So there's four messages total on my screen.' Find and fix the duplicate-rendering bug in the shared chat component (public/framework/ext/Chat/ — ChatPanel.js is likely where it renders, per CLAUDE.md law 6 there is one chat component used everywhere, so the fix applies everywhere it's used). Reproduce it (likely a double-append from two listeners, a re-render duplicating DOM nodes, or a reconnect replaying already-seen lines) and fix at the root, not with a dedup patch unless that is the actual right fix. Land the task per the finish-task skill.

assign.now: root cause found: ux/Dictate/chat.js's attach() wires up BOTH Session.watch() (file polling) and Session.stream() (SSE) to the same draw() callback. Session.js's own doc comment confirms stream's 'line' events are meant to arrive before the next poll tick, so watch() is expected to later redeliver the exact same line from the file — by design, both channels carry every real line, but nothing dedupes between them. own_ats only catches the owner's OWN echoed sends, never an assistant reply, so every assistant line (fast and smart) gets drawn twice — exactly 'four messages total' for two real replies.

decision.question: how to stop the double draw without losing either channel
options: drop Session.stream()'s line events, rely on watch() polling alone
drop Session.watch(), rely on stream() (SSE) alone
add a dedup Set around draw() so a line already drawn by either channel is never drawn twice
decision.chose: add a dedup Set around draw() so a line already drawn by either channel is never drawn twice
decision.why: this is the missing half of an already-intended pattern (own_ats already dedupes the owner's own echo this exact way) — watch() and stream() each do a real, separate job (watch = full-history catch-up and reconnect safety; stream = low-latency push so a reply does not wait for the next 1.5s poll tick), so dropping either regresses a feature on purpose; the actual bug is that nothing ever guarded the SECOND copy of a line from drawing.

assign.title: Chat: fixed assistant replies drawing twice
assign.outcome:
**Fixed: every assistant reply drew twice in the chat.** [`ux/Dictate/chat.js`](http://monorepo.localhost/framework/ux/Dictate/) listens for new lines two ways at once (an SSE push and a file poll) and only the owner's own echoed message was ever deduped against that — so each assistant's reply became two bubbles, four messages for two real replies.

- [x] found why — both channels deliver every real line by design; the dedup only ever covered the owner's own send, never a reply
- [x] fixed at the root, in the one shared chat every surface uses (✦ sheet, drawer, cards, this page's own demo): [chat.js](http://monorepo.localhost/framework/ux/Dictate/chat.js), docs updated at [doc/chat.md](http://monorepo.localhost/framework/ux/Dictate/doc/chat/)
- [ ] proved it live — blocked: this session's `node` and every site/MCP tool call returned 'requires approval' with no approver reachable (confirmed on a fresh subagent too); verified instead by a full manual read of the diff and a repo-wide grep confirming no other live surface shares the bug
